nodes.name: Free AI (OpenAI-compatible)
nodes.notes: Set the URL + model to any free OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Groq, OpenRouter free tier, a self-hosted Ollama, etc.). Add an httpHeaderAuth credential 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. The model is just a string — update it when your free model changes.

meta.description: Receives {task, services, schema_prompt, docs} from the TutiPays AI Integration Studio (n8n mode), asks a free OpenAI-compatible model to draft a dynamic-driver config, and returns { config }. Import into n8n, set the HTTP Request node's URL/model + Authorization credential, activate, then paste this webhook's Production URL into TutiPays → AI Integration Studio (mode: n8n webhook).
